translations.zh: 李重胤，宋州下邑人。
translations.literal: Li Chongyin was a native of Xiayi in Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chongyin came from Xiayi in Songzhou.

translations.zh: 狀貌雄武，初在黃巢黨中，推為剛鷙。
translations.literal: In bearing he was bold and martial; at first among Huang Chao's party he was acclaimed as fierce and harsh.
translations.idiomatic: Bold and martial in bearing, he was first acclaimed among Huang Chao's followers as fierce and harsh.

translations.zh: 唐中和四年五月，同尚讓、李讜等率眾至繁台，與太祖之軍相拒。
translations.literal: In the fifth month of Zhonghe 4 of Tang, together with Shang Rang, Li Dang, and others he led masses to Fantai and faced the Founder's army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Zhonghe 4 he joined Shang Rang, Li Dang, and others at Fantai to face the Founder's army.

translations.zh: 及巢寇漸衰，乃率眾來降。
translations.literal: When Chao's bandits gradually declined, he then led the masses to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: As Chao's cause waned, he led his men to surrender.

translations.zh: 太祖素識之，拔用不次，署為先鋒步軍都頭。
translations.literal: The Founder had long known him and raised him out of turn, appointing him vanguard infantry commander.
translations.idiomatic: The Founder already knew him and promoted him out of turn, making him vanguard infantry commander.

translations.zh: 與胡真援河陽，逼懷州。
translations.literal: With He Zhen he relieved Heyang and pressed Huai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: With He Zhen he relieved Heyang and pressed Huai prefecture.

translations.zh: 重胤以部下兵突之，射中蕃將安休休。
translations.literal: Chongyin with his command's troops charged them and shot the foreign general An Xiuxiu.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyin charged with his own troops and shot the foreign general An Xiuxiu.

translations.zh: 又令與李讜率騎軍至陝，應接郭言，回次澠池，破賊帥黃花子之眾，改滑州夾馬指揮使。
translations.literal: He was again ordered with Li Dang to lead cavalry to Shan to link with Guo Yan; returning he halted at Mianchi and broke the band of the rebel chief Huang Huazi; he was changed to Huazhou Jiamma commander.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered with Li Dang to lead cavalry to Shan to link with Guo Yan; on the return march he stopped at Mianchi and broke the band of the rebel chief Huang Huazi, then became Jiamma commander at Huazhou.

translations.zh: 蔡賊圍汴，重胤以步兵攻下三寨，擄獲甚多。
translations.literal: When Cai bandits besieged Bian, Chongyin with infantry stormed three camps and captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: When Cai rebels besieged Bian, Chongyin's infantry took three camps and captured many prisoners.

translations.zh: 太祖大舉伐宗權，俾重胤以滑兵為先鋒。
translations.literal: When the Founder launched a great campaign against Zongquan, he had Chongyin lead the Huazhou troops as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founder launched a major campaign against Zongquan, he put Chongyin and the Huazhou troops in the vanguard.

translations.zh: 及東討徐州，下豐、蕭二邑，轉右廂馬步軍指揮使。
translations.literal: When he campaigned east against Xuzhou and took the districts of Feng and Xiao, he was transferred to Right Wing horse-and-foot commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the eastern campaign against Xuzhou he took Feng and Xiao and was made commander of the Right Wing horse-and-foot corps.

translations.zh: 大順元年秋，從郴王友裕收澤州，與晉軍戰於馬牢川，王師敗績，回守河陽。
translations.literal: In autumn of Dashun 1 he followed Prince of Chen Youyu in recovering Zezhou; the imperial army fought Jin forces at Malao River, was defeated, and withdrew to hold Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of Dashun 1 he followed Prince of Chen Youyu to recover Zezhou; at Malao River the imperial army was beaten by the Jin and fell back to Heyang.

translations.zh: 太祖謂諸將曰：「李讜、重胤違我節度，不能立功，頗辜任使。」
translations.literal: The Founder told the generals: "Li Dang and Chongyin violated my command and could not establish merit—they have quite betrayed the trust placed in them."
translations.idiomatic: The Founder told his generals: "Li Dang and Chongyin disobeyed my orders and won no merit—they have badly failed the trust I placed in them."

translations.zh: 於是與李讜並戮於河橋。
translations.literal: Thereupon he and Li Dang were together executed at He Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: He and Li Dang were then executed together at He Bridge.

translations.zh: 範居實，絳州翼城人。
translations.literal: Fan Jushi was a native of Yicheng in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Jushi came from Yicheng in Jiangzhou.

translations.zh: 事太祖，初為隊將，從討巢、蔡有功。
translations.literal: Serving the Founder, at first he was a squad commander; following campaigns against Chao and Cai he had merit.
translations.idiomatic: Serving the Founder, he began as a squad commander and won merit in the campaigns against Chao and Cai.

translations.zh: 又從朱珍收滑州，改左廂都虞候。
translations.literal: He again followed Zhu Zhen in recovering Huazhou and was changed to Left Wing chief adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Zhu Zhen in recovering Huazhou and was made Left Wing chief adjutant.

translations.zh: 預破兗、鄆功。
translations.literal: He shared in the merit of breaking Yan and Yun.
translations.idiomatic: He shared in the victories over Yan and Yun.

translations.zh: 遷感義都頭、鄭州馬軍指揮使。
translations.literal: He was transferred to Ganyi squad chief and Zhengzhou cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: He became Ganyi squad chief and cavalry commander at Zhengzhou.

translations.zh: 幽州劉仁恭舉眾南下，寇魏郡北，居實與葛從周、張存敬率兵救魏，大破幽、滄之眾於內黃。
translations.literal: When Youzhou's Liu Rengong raised masses and marched south, raiding north of Wei commandery, Jushi with Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing led troops to rescue Wei and greatly defeated the You and Cang forces at Neihuang.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Rengong of Youzhou marched south and raided north of Wei, Jushi joined Ge Congzhou and Zhang Cunjing to relieve Wei and routed the You and Cang armies at Neihuang.

translations.zh: 太祖迎昭宗於岐下，以居實為河中馬軍都指揮使。
translations.literal: When the Founder welcomed Zhaozong at Qixia, he made Jushi Hezhong cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: When the Founder welcomed Zhaozong at Qixia, he made Jushi cavalry commander of Hezhong.

translations.zh: 及昭宗還京，賜迎鑾毅勇功臣，遙領錦州刺史，又遷左龍驤馬軍都指揮使。
translations.literal: When Zhaozong returned to the capital, he was granted the title Resolute and Brave Merit Lord of the Imperial Welcome, held Jing prefecture in absentia, and was again transferred to Left Dragon Flying cavalry commander.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaozong returned to the capital, he received the title Resolute and Brave Merit Lord of the Imperial Welcome, held Jing prefecture in absentia, and was made Left Dragon Flying cavalry commander.

translations.zh: 從征淮南回，改登州刺史，轉左神勇軍使。
translations.literal: Returning from the Huainan campaign, he was changed to Dengzhou prefect and transferred to Left Divine Valor commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After the Huainan campaign he became prefect of Dengzhou and then commissioner of the Left Divine Valor Guard.

translations.zh: 開平元年，用軍於潞州，命居實統軍以解澤州之圍。
translations.literal: In Kaiping 1, when troops were deployed at Luzhou, Jushi was ordered to command an army to lift the siege of Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaiping 1, when troops were deployed at Luzhou, he was ordered to command an army to lift the siege of Zezhou.

translations.zh: 授耀州刺史，令以郡兵屯固鎮，尋除澤州刺史。
translations.literal: He was appointed Yaozhou prefect and ordered to station the prefecture's troops at Guzhen; soon he was removed to Zezhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He was made prefect of Yaozhou and ordered to station his troops at Guzhen; soon he was transferred to prefect of Zezhou.

translations.zh: 居實拳勇善戰，頗立軍功，在郡以戎備不理，詔追赴闕，暴其玩寇之罪而斬之。
translations.literal: Jushi was fierce in fist and brave in battle and considerably established military merit; in the prefecture he neglected military readiness; an edict recalled him to court, exposed his crime of treating the enemy lightly, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Jushi was a fierce fighter who won solid merit, but as prefect he neglected defense; recalled to court, he was condemned for treating the enemy lightly and executed.
